svg.text: One file-access base under every lightweight reader & writer — capability-tiered FILE / FUSE routing on read, governed MANAGED / EXTERNAL / FUSE modes on write, chosen per runtime
the resolver picks per source & size
blocks fetched on demand, no full load
FUSE tier or direct-open probe fails
the light-tier engine reads the window
MANAGED owns bytes · EXTERNAL references · FUSE plain
no FILE column — path STRING / raster BINARY
FUSE — plain Delta, no FILE column
opt-in CLUSTER BY path — then run OPTIMIZE <table>
the same pipeline runs on any runtime
opt in to FILE only for its governance
the default on every lightweight reader & writer
explicit FILE on a FUSE-only runtime → clear ValueError
the message names the DBR upgrade path & the auto fallback
